_comment: Degrees, single-sourced for both CVs and the site's Experience logo wall.
Dates are YYYY-MM. The one-pager prints '<level> <subject>, <end year>'; the biosketch
prints '<level>[ (<qualifier>)] in <subject>[, <honours>]' with 'Mon YYYY - Mon YYYY'.
An institution with a `logo` appears on the site's Experience wall, before the jobs.
Ids are cited from an application as `edu:<degree id>`.
